subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this external lease-bound session-orchestration API and its persisted replay model as a supported core Gateway contract, rather than requiring it to use an owner plugin or a narrower generic extension seam?
rationale: This is a broad new externally consumable Gateway and state contract, not a repair to an established public behavior; repository policy places optional integration-specific behavior at plugin boundaries unless maintainers approve a necessary generic core API.

options.title: Require a plugin or narrower seam
options.body: Keep external-orchestrator policy and lifecycle state out of core unless a concrete missing generic SDK or Gateway capability is identified.

options.title: Sponsor a reduced core contract
options.body: Approve a documented generic lease/session capability, then require a smaller API design, compatibility plan, and complete upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Accept this contract as proposed
options.body: Adopt the seven-method Gateway surface and snapshot model as a supported core API, with explicit ownership for its release and compatibility obligations.

recommendation.title: Require a plugin or narrower seam
recommendation.body: Keep external-orchestrator policy and lifecycle state out of core unless a concrete missing generic SDK or Gateway capability is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: A named Gateway/session feature-history owner could not be established safely from the available read-only context.
